SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
	 , B.USER_NAME
     , PROJECT_CODE
     , A.CREATED_BY
     , COUNT(1) COUNTS
	 , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112)  MODIFY_DATE
	 , ( select x.iso_yyyyww from [SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] x where x.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112) ) yyyyww
	 , case datepart(dw,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) when 1 then 'SUN'
	                                        when 2 then 'MON'
											when 3 then 'TUE'
											when 4 then 'WED'
											when 5 then 'THU'
											when 6 then 'FRI'
											when 7 then 'SAT' end day_of_week
	 , datepart(HH,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) hour
     , CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),120)  LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_H            A with(nolock)
   ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] B with(nolock)
   ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C with(nolock)
WHERE A.CREATED_BY = B.USER_ID
  AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
  AND A.last_update_date > getdate() - 14

GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
     , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
	 , B.USER_NAME
     , PROJECT_CODE
     , A.CREATED_BY
	 , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112)
	 , datepart(dw,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
	 , datepart(HH,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID,A.MEASURE, D.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.OWNER, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, V.NICK_NAME, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY
  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
  AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
  AND B.VALID_YN   = 'Y'
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
  AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  INNER JOIN DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V V
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.ITEM_ID = V.ITEM_ID
  INNER JOIN [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] D
  ON C.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID
  AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
 WHERE A.YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(WEEK, DATEDIFF(WEEK, 0, DATEADD( DD, -1*7,  GETDATE() ) ), 7) , 112)
   AND (
          SELECT COUNT(1)
		    FROM [DBO].[SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE] P
		  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
		    AND A.PROJECT_CODE = P.PROJECT_CODE
			AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = P.SCM_SITE_ID
			AND A.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
			AND A.DOM_EXP = P.DOM_EXP
			AND A.FCST_TYPE = P.FCST_TYPE
			AND P.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM [DBO].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.YYYYMMDD )
                                    AND A.INCOTERMS = P.INCOTERMS
			AND P.PRICE > 0
       ) = 0
   --AND A.MEASURE  IN ( 'RTF' , 'MKT_FCST' )
   AND A.MEASURE IN ( SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DQ_NOPRICE_MEASURE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SEGMENT2 = @PARAM1 )
   AND A.QTY <> 0
   AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN @PARAM1 = '' THEN A.DIVISION_ID ELSE @PARAM1 END
UNION ALL
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID,A.MEASURE, D.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.OWNER, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, V.NICK_NAME, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY
  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
  AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
  AND B.VALID_YN   = 'Y'
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
  AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  INNER JOIN DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V V
  ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.ITEM_ID = V.ITEM_ID
  INNER JOIN [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] E
  ON  (SELECT TOP 1 TOKEN FROM [DBO].[STRING_SPLIT](B.OWNER, ',')) = E.USER_ID
  INNER JOIN [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] D
  ON E.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID
 WHERE A.YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(WEEK, DATEDIFF(WEEK, 0, DATEADD( DD, -1*7,  GETDATE() ) ), 7) , 112)
   AND (
          SELECT COUNT(1)
		    FROM [DBO].[SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE] P
		  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
		    AND A.PROJECT_CODE = P.PROJECT_CODE
			AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = P.SCM_SITE_ID
			AND A.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
			AND A.DOM_EXP = P.DOM_EXP
			AND A.FCST_TYPE = P.FCST_TYPE
			AND P.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM [DBO].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.YYYYMMDD )
                                    AND A.INCOTERMS = P.INCOTERMS
			AND P.PRICE > 0
       ) = 0
   --AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'RTF' , 'MKT_FCST' )
   AND A.MEASURE IN ( SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DQ_NOPRICE_MEASURE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SEGMENT2 = @PARAM1 )
   AND A.QTY <> 0
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN @PARAM1 = '' THEN A.DIVISION_ID ELSE @PARAM1 END

select z.division_id,c.[DEPT_NAME_KO], b.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, z.SCM_SITE_ID, z.PROJECT_CODE, d.project_name, z.ITEM_ID, z.DOM_EXP,  case z.fcst_type when 'MPS' then N'양산' when 'SMC' then N'셈플' when 'ETC' then N'기타' end fcst_type
     ,  case e.item_type when 'P' then N'제품' when 'Q' then N'상품' when 'R' then N'자재' else  e.item_type end item_type 
     , INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID,  measure,YYYYMMDD, sum(ver_A) ver_A, sum(ver_b) ver_B, sum(ver_A) - sum(ver_b) GAP
  from (
  select a.division_id, a.SCM_SITE_ID, a.PROJECT_CODE, a.ITEM_ID, a.DOM_EXP, a.FCST_TYPE, a.INCOTERMS, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, measure, a.YYYYMMDD, a.qty ver_A, 0 ver_b
    from dm_pln_mkt_fcst_c a
  where 1=1
    and division_id = @PARAM1
	and a.version_no = @PARAM2
	and a.qty > 0
  UNION

  select a.division_id, a.SCM_SITE_ID, a.PROJECT_CODE, a.ITEM_ID, a.DOM_EXP, a.FCST_TYPE, a.INCOTERMS, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, measure, a.YYYYMMDD, 0 ver_A, a.qty ver_b
    from dm_pln_mkt_fcst_c a
  where 1=1
    and division_id = @PARAM1
    and a.version_no = @PARAM3
		and a.qty > 0
	 ) z
        ,scm_mst_site b
	  ,[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] c
	  ,scm_mst_project d
	  ,[DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] e
where z.measure = 'MKT_FCST'
   and z.scm_site_id = b.scm_site_id
   and b.dept_id = c.dept_id
   and z.project_code = d.PROJECT_CODE
   and z.division_id = e.division_id
   and z.item_id = e.item_id
group by z.division_id, z.SCM_SITE_ID, z.PROJECT_CODE, z.ITEM_ID, z.DOM_EXP, z.FCST_TYPE, z.INCOTERMS, z.PLANT_SITE_ID, z.measure,z.YYYYMMDD, e.item_type,c.[DEPT_NAME_KO], b.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER,d.project_name

DESCRIPTION: ESS 출하일 기준 MKT FCST 확인
DQ_TEXT:
/*
##############  필  독 ##############
LOOKUP -> LOOKUP TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 조회
하단의 LOOKUP VALUE 값이 설정된 SITE만 
BOD L/T 와 출하일 값이 출력됩니다.
####################################
*/

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, C.[DEPT_NAME_KO], B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER ,A.SCM_SITE_ID,  A.PROJECT_CODE,  D.PROJECT_NAME
	  ,D.PROJECT_OWNER
	  ,(
          SELECT Z.USER_NAME
		    FROM [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] Z WITH(NOLOCK)
		   WHERE Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
	   ) PROJECT_OWNER_KO
      , A.ITEM_ID, E.ITEM_NAME, CASE E.ITEM_TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN N'제품' WHEN 'Q' THEN N'상품' WHEN 'R' THEN N'자재' ELSE  E.ITEM_TYPE END ITEM_TYPE 
      , CASE FCST_TYPE WHEN 'MPS' THEN N'양산' WHEN 'SMC' THEN N'셈플' WHEN 'ETC' THEN N'기타' END FCST_TYPE
 	  , A.INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD  AS "매출일"
      ,ISNULL( (


          SELECT DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS INT)
		   FROM [DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
		  WHERE 1=1
		    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 
			AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
		    AND U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
			AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE

       ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
	   ) AS "BOD_LT"
	 ,  CONVERT( VARCHAR, 
	     DATEADD( DAY ,- ISNULL( (


														  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS INT)
														   FROM [DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
														  WHERE 1=1
														    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT'
															AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
															AND U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
															AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE


													   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
													   ) , CAST(YYYYMMDD AS DATETIME) 
                ), 112 ) AS "출하일"
      ,ISNULL( (
				SELECT MAX( LT_TOTAL )
				  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
				 WHERE 1=1
				   AND X.PRIORITY = (
									   SELECT MIN( Z.PRIORITY )
											  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V Z WITH(NOLOCK)
											 WHERE 1=1
											   AND Z.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											   AND Z.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
											   AND Z.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
											   ) 

				   AND X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
				   AND X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                   AND X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                   AND X.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
	   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END ) AS "SCP_BOD_LT"
	 ,  CONVERT( VARCHAR, 
	     DATEADD( DAY ,- ISNULL( (
											SELECT MAX( LT_TOTAL )
											  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
											 WHERE X.PRIORITY = 1
											   AND X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											   AND X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                                                                                                       AND X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                                                       AND X.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
								   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
													   ) , CAST(YYYYMMDD AS DATETIME) 
                ), 112 ) AS "SCP_BOD_출하일"
	  ,QTY
,E.Energe as Energy , E.Cell_Quantity --20200116 KHSONG ADD
 -- INTO #ESS_EXFACTORY_FCST
  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A WITH(NOLOCK)
        ,SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] E WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = 82
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
   AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
   AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
   AND QTY >  0
   -- AND YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)
   AND YYYYMMDD >= SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112), 1, 6 ) + '01'

DESCRIPTION: cutoff 버젼별 ESS 출하일 기준 MKT FCST 확인

/*
##############  필  독 ##############
Lookup -> Lookup Type = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 조회
하단의 Lookup Value 값이 설정된 Site만 
BOD L/T 와 출하일 값이 출력됩니다.
####################################
*/

select a.division_id, c.[DEPT_NAME_KO], b.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER ,a.scm_site_id,  a.project_code,  d.project_name
	  ,D.PROJECT_OWNER
	  ,(
          select z.user_name
		    from [dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] z WITH(NOLOCK)
		   where z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
	   ) PROJECT_OWNER_KO
      , a.item_id, e.item_name, case e.item_type when 'P' then N'제품' when 'Q' then N'상품' when 'R' then N'자재' else  e.item_type end item_type 
      , case fcst_type when 'MPS' then N'양산' when 'SMC' then N'셈플' when 'ETC' then N'기타' end fcst_type
 	  , a.incoterms, yyyymmdd  as "매출일"
      ,ISNULL( (


          SELECT DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS int)
		   FROM [DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
		  WHERE 1=1
		    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 
			AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
		    AND U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
			AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE

       ),  case when a.incoterms = 'EXW' then 0 else null end 
	   ) as "BOD_LT"
	 ,  convert( varchar, 
	     dateadd( day ,- ISNULL( (
														  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS int)
														   FROM [DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
														  WHERE 1=1
														    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT'
															AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
															AND U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
															AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE
													   ),  case when a.incoterms = 'EXW' then 0 else null end 
													   ) , cast(yyyymmdd as datetime) 
                ), 112 ) as "출하일"
      ,ISNULL( (


				SELECT MAX( LT_TOTAL )
				  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
				 WHERE 1=1
				   AND X.PRIORITY = (
									   SELECT MIN( Z.PRIORITY )
											  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V Z WITH(NOLOCK)
											 WHERE 1=1
											   AND Z.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											   AND Z.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
											   AND Z.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
											   ) 


				   AND X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
				   AND X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                   and x.bod_valid_yn = 'Y'
	   ),  case when a.incoterms = 'EXW' then 0 else null end ) as "SCP_BOD_LT"
	 ,  convert( varchar, 
	     dateadd( day ,- ISNULL( (


											SELECT MAX( LT_TOTAL )
											  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
											 WHERE 1=1
											   AND X.PRIORITY = (
																   SELECT MIN( Z.PRIORITY )
																		  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V Z WITH(NOLOCK)
																		 WHERE 1=1
																		   AND Z.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
																		   AND Z.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
																		   AND Z.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
																		   ) 


											   AND X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											   AND X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                                                                                                       and x.bod_valid_yn = 'Y'
								   ),  case when a.incoterms = 'EXW' then 0 else null end 
													   ) , cast(yyyymmdd as datetime) 
                ), 112 ) as "SCP_BOD_출하일"

	  ,QTY
,E.ENERGE as ENERGY , E.CELL_QUANTITY --20200116 KHSONG ADD
 -- into #ESS_EXFACTORY_FCST
  from (
        select division_id, scm_site_id, project_code,item_id, fcst_type, incoterms, yyyymmdd, measure, qty from dm_pln_mkt_fcst_c WITH(NOLOCK) where version_no = @PARAM1  AND DIVISION_ID = '82'
		UNION
		select division_id, scm_site_id, project_code,item_id, fcst_type, incoterms, yyyymmdd, measure, qty from dm_pln_mkt_fcst WITH(NOLOCK) where yyyymmdd >= substring(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112), 1, 6 ) + '01' and yyyymmdd < CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(getdate(), 'MON')), 112)
AND DIVISION_ID = '82'

	    ) a
        ,scm_mst_site b WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] c WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,scm_mst_project d WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] e WITH(NOLOCK)
 where a.division_id = 82
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   and a.scm_site_id = b.scm_site_id
   and b.dept_id = c.dept_id
   and a.project_code = d.PROJECT_CODE
   and a.division_id = e.division_id
   and a.item_id = e.item_id
   and measure = 'MKT_FCST'

      WHERE  md.lookup_type = 'SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_ANL'

            ,log_type
            ,log_count
            ,lb.log_message
            ,lb.description
            ,lb.creation_date
            ,md.description batch_period

      LEFT JOIN   scm_sys_log_batch lb WITH(NOLOCK)

      AND    convert(char(8), lb.creation_date, 112) = DBO.FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(@PARAM_YYYYMMDD, CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112))

-- (1) MKT_FCST○,SALES_RESULT○
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID,C.CUSTOMER_CODE,C.CUSTOMER_NAME, A.SCM_SITE_ID, C.SALES_SITE_ID AS RESULT_SITE_ID,SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6) AS SALES_YYYYMM, SUM(A.QTY) AS FCST_QTY,SUM(C.SALES_QTY) AS SALES_QTY,N'(1) MKT_FCST=○,SALES_RESULT=○' AS 'TYPE'
	FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER B WITH(NOLOCK)
			ON( A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID)
		INNER JOIN DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF C WITH(NOLOCK)
			ON( A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SALES_SITE_ID
			AND B.SOLDTO_CODE = C.CUSTOMER_CODE
			)
		AND a.division_id = ( CASE WHEN @PARAM_DIVSION_ID = '' THEN A.DIVISION_ID ELSE @PARAM_DIVSION_ID END )
		AND a.measure = 'MKT_FCST'
		AND a.yyyymmdd between CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN a.yyyymmdd ELSE  SUBSTRING(@PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM,1,6) + '01'  END -- 조회월의 1일
						   and CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN a.yyyymmdd ELSE  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(MM, +1, SUBSTRING(@PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM,1,6) + '01'), 112) ), 112)  END  -- 조회월의 말일
		AND b.valid_yn = 'Y'
		AND a.qty <> 0 
		AND C.SALES_YYYYMM = CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN C.SALES_YYYYMM ELSE  @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  END
		AND C.cost_item = ''
		AND len(C.customer_code) > 4
GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID,C.CUSTOMER_CODE,C.CUSTOMER_NAME, A.SCM_SITE_ID, C.SALES_SITE_ID,SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6)

UNION ALL

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID,B.SOLDTO_CODE AS CUSTOMER_CODE, '' AS CUSTOMER_NAME, A.SCM_SITE_ID, '' AS RESULT_SITE_ID,SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6),SUM(A.QTY) AS FCST_QTY,'0' AS SALES_QTY,N'(2) MKT_FCST=○,SALES_RESULT=Ⅹ' AS 'TYPE'
	FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
	INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER B WITH(NOLOCK)
		ON( A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
		AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID)
	where a.division_id = ( CASE WHEN @PARAM_DIVSION_ID = '' THEN A.DIVISION_ID ELSE @PARAM_DIVSION_ID END )
	and a.measure = 'MKT_FCST'
	AND a.yyyymmdd between CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN a.yyyymmdd ELSE  SUBSTRING(@PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM,1,6) + '01'  END -- 조회월의 1일
						and CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN a.yyyymmdd ELSE  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(MM, +1, SUBSTRING(@PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM,1,6) + '01'), 112) ), 112)  END  -- 조회월의 말일
	and b.valid_yn = 'Y'
	and a.qty <> 0 
	AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT DISTINCT C.DIVISION_ID, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, '' AS SOLDTO_CODE, '' AS SCM_SITE_ID, C.SALES_SITE_ID AS RESULT_SITE_ID

				AND C.SALES_YYYYMM = CASE WHEN @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  = '' THEN C.SALES_YYYYMM ELSE  @PARAM_SALES_YYYYMM  END
				and cost_item = ''
				and len(C.customer_code) > 4
				AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
				AND B.SOLDTO_CODE = C.CUSTOMER_CODE
					)
GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID,B.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID,SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6)

DQ_NAME: ESS REQ, CIQ FCST By Current
DESCRIPTION: ESS 출하요청, CIQ FCST By Current
DQ_TEXT:
SELECT DT.DIVISION_ID , DT.DEPT_NAME_KO , DT.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , DT.SCM_SITE_ID , DT.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , DT.PROJECT_CODE , DT.PROJECT_NAME , DT.PROJECT_OWNER ,DT.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, DT.ITEM_ID
     , DT.ITEM_NAME , DT.FCST_TYPE , DT.INCOTERMS , DT.DUE_DATE_MKT , DT.QTY , DT.ENERGY , DT.CELL_QUANTITY
     , DT.BOD_ID , DT.DAYS_MON, DT.DAYS_TUE, DT.DAYS_WED, DT.DAYS_THU, DT.DAYS_FRI, DT.DAYS_SAT, DT.DAYS_SUN
     , DT.LT_TOTAL, DT.OSP_LT
   , CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD, (CASE WHEN DT.INCOTERMS IN ('A01','Z01','Z04','EXW','FCA','FAS')
                                       THEN 0 ELSE DT.VOYAGE_CHECK_LT END + DT.SHIP_LT_TOTAL) * -1, DT.SHIP_PLAN_CAL),112)  AS SHIP_REQ_DATE
   , CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD, (CASE WHEN DT.INCOTERMS IN ('A01','Z01','Z04','EXW','FCA','FAS')
	                                THEN 0 ELSE DT.VOYAGE_CHECK_LT END + DT.SHIP_LT_TOTAL + DT.OSP_LT) * -1, DT.SHIP_PLAN_CAL),112)  AS CIQ_DATE
FROM   (
        SELECT 
               A.DIVISION_ID , A.DEPT_NAME_KO , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE , A.PROJECT_NAME , A.PROJECT_OWNER ,A.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, A.ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.DUE_DATE_MKT , A.QTY , A.ENERGY , A.CELL_QUANTITY
             , A.BOD_ID , A.DAYS_MON, A.DAYS_TUE, A.DAYS_WED, A.DAYS_THU, A.DAYS_FRI, A.DAYS_SAT, A.DAYS_SUN
             , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND , A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING , A.LT_VOYAGE , A.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
             , A.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN , A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL , A.LT_TOTAL
             , A.LT_INLAND , A.GAP_LT, ISNULL(LT.LT_DAY,0) AS OSP_LT
             , DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT)) AS SHIP_PLAN_CAL
             , DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) AS DAY_IDX
             , CASE --  ① 일요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 1
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ② 월요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 2
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ③ 화요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 3
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ④ 수요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 4
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑤ 목요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 5
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑥ 금요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 6
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑦ 토요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 7
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    ELSE 0
               END  AS VOYAGE_CHECK_LT
      , A.BOD_VALID_YN

        FROM   (
 
                SELECT MK.DIVISION_ID , MK.DEPT_NAME_KO , MK.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , MK.SCM_SITE_ID , MK.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , MK.PROJECT_CODE , MK.PROJECT_NAME , MK.PROJECT_OWNER ,MK.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, MK.ITEM_ID
                     , MK.ITEM_NAME , MK.FCST_TYPE , MK.INCOTERMS , MK.DUE_DATE_MKT , MK.QTY , MK.ENERGY , MK.CELL_QUANTITY
                     , BD.BOD_ID , BD.DAYS_MON, BD.DAYS_TUE, BD.DAYS_WED, BD.DAYS_THU, BD.DAYS_FRI, BD.DAYS_SAT, BD.DAYS_SUN
                     , BD.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND , BD.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING , BD.LT_VOYAGE , BD.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                     , BD.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, BD.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN , BD.SHIP_LT_TOTAL , BD.LT_TOTAL
                     , BD.LT_INLAND , BD.GAP_LT, BD.BOD_VALID_YN
                FROM   (
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , C.DEPT_NAME_KO , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , PR.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE , D.PROJECT_NAME , D.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , (
                                SELECT Z.USER_NAME
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO Z WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
                               ) AS PROJECT_OWNER_KO
                             , A.ITEM_ID , IT.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.YYYYMMDD  AS DUE_DATE_MKT
                             , A.QTY , IT.ENERGE  AS ENERGY , IT.CELL_QUANTITY
                        FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A WITH(NOLOCK)
                               LEFT OUTER JOIN
                               (
                                SELECT PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY PR
                                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = '82'
                                AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                --AND    CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) BETWEEN FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TO_YYYYMMDD
                                AND TO_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)
                                AND    (PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-P' OR PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-A')
                                GROUP  BY PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                               ) PR
                               ON  A.DIVISION_ID = PR.DIVISION_ID
                               AND A.ITEM_ID     = PR.ITEM_ID
                             , SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SITE E WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , [DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] IT WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = '82'
                        AND    A.MEASURE     IN ('MKT_FCST', 'AS_IN_REQ')
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
                        AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID  = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = IT.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID     = IT.ITEM_ID
                        AND    IT.ITEM_TYPE  = 'P'
                        AND    A.QTY         > 0
                        AND    E.VMI_YN      = 'N'
                        AND    A.YYYYMMDD    >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)
                        AND  (@PARAM_ITEM_ID = '' OR A.ITEM_ID = @PARAM_ITEM_ID)                        
                        AND  (@PARAM_PROJECT_CODE = '' OR A.PROJECT_CODE = @PARAM_PROJECT_CODE)
                        UNION  ALL

                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , C.DEPT_NAME_KO , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , PR.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE , D.PROJECT_NAME , D.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , (
                                SELECT Z.USER_NAME
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO Z WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
                               ) AS PROJECT_OWNER_KO
                             , A.ITEM_ID , IT.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.YYYYMMDD  AS DUE_DATE_MKT
                             , A.QTY , IT.ENERGE  AS ENERGY , IT.CELL_QUANTITY
                        FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A WITH(NOLOCK)
                               LEFT OUTER JOIN
                               (
                                SELECT PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY PR
                                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = '82'
                                AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                --AND    CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) BETWEEN FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TO_YYYYMMDD
                                AND TO_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)
                                AND    (PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-P' OR PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-A')
                                GROUP  BY PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                               ) PR
                               ON  A.DIVISION_ID = PR.DIVISION_ID
                               AND A.ITEM_ID     = PR.ITEM_ID
                             , SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SITE E WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , [DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] IT WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = '82'
                        AND    A.MEASURE     = 'VMI_IN_REQ'
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
                        AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID  = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = IT.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID     = IT.ITEM_ID
                        AND    IT.ITEM_TYPE  = 'P'
                        AND    A.QTY         > 0
                        AND    A.YYYYMMDD    >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)
                        AND    E.VMI_YN      = 'Y'                        
                        AND  (@PARAM_ITEM_ID = '' OR A.ITEM_ID = @PARAM_ITEM_ID)                       
                        AND  (@PARAM_PROJECT_CODE = '' OR A.PROJECT_CODE = @PARAM_PROJECT_CODE)
                       ) MK
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN 
                       (
                       SELECT DISTINCT
                              A.BOD_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.INCOTERMS, B.ITEM_ID
                            , A.DAYS_MON, A.DAYS_TUE, A.DAYS_WED, A.DAYS_THU, A.DAYS_FRI, A.DAYS_SAT, A.DAYS_SUN
                            , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, A.LT_VOYAGE, A.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                            , A.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, A.LT_TOTAL
                            , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING AS LT_INLAND
                            , CASE WHEN A.LT_TOTAL <= A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
                                   THEN 0
                                   ELSE A.LT_TOTAL - (A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING)
                              END  AS GAP_LT
                            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.INCOTERMS, B.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.PRIORITY, A.LT_TOTAL DESC, A.BOD_ID) AS BOD_PRIORITY
                            , B.VALID_YN AS BOD_VALID_YN
                       FROM   SCP_MST_BOD_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
                            , SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM B WITH(NOLOCK)
                       WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID     = '82'
                       AND    A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND    A.BOD_ID          = B.BOD_ID
                       AND    A.BOD_VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                       --AND    B.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                       ) BD
                       ON  MK.DIVISION_ID = BD.DIVISION_ID
                       AND MK.SCM_SITE_ID = BD.TO_SITE
                       AND MK.PLANT_SITE_ID = BD.FROM_SITE
                       AND MK.INCOTERMS     = BD.INCOTERMS
                       AND MK.ITEM_ID       = BD.ITEM_ID
                       AND BD.BOD_PRIORITY  = 1            

               ) A
               LEFT OUTER JOIN
               SCP_MST_OPERATION_LT LT WITH(NOLOCK)
               ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = LT.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID   = LT.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID         = LT.ITEM_ID
               AND LT.LT_OPERATION   = 'OSP_LT'
       ) DT
 WHERE ISNULL(DT.BOD_VALID_YN,'Y') = 'Y'
--ORDER  BY 1,3,4,5

DQ_NAME: ESS REQ, CIQ FCST By Version
DESCRIPTION: ESS 출하요청, CIQ FCST By Version
DQ_TEXT:
SELECT DT.DIVISION_ID , DT.DEPT_NAME_KO , DT.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , DT.SCM_SITE_ID , DT.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , DT.PROJECT_CODE , DT.PROJECT_NAME , DT.PROJECT_OWNER ,DT.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, DT.ITEM_ID
     , DT.ITEM_NAME , DT.FCST_TYPE , DT.INCOTERMS , DT.DUE_DATE_MKT , DT.QTY , DT.ENERGY , DT.CELL_QUANTITY
     , DT.BOD_ID , DT.DAYS_MON, DT.DAYS_TUE, DT.DAYS_WED, DT.DAYS_THU, DT.DAYS_FRI, DT.DAYS_SAT, DT.DAYS_SUN
     , DT.LT_TOTAL, DT.OSP_LT, DT.GAP_LT, DT.VOYAGE_CHECK_LT
   , CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD, (CASE WHEN DT.INCOTERMS IN ('A01','Z01','Z04','EXW','FCA','FAS')
                                       THEN 0 ELSE DT.VOYAGE_CHECK_LT END + DT.SHIP_LT_TOTAL) * -1, DT.SHIP_PLAN_CAL),112)  AS SHIP_REQ_DATE
   , CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD, (CASE WHEN DT.INCOTERMS IN ('A01','Z01','Z04','EXW','FCA','FAS')
                                       THEN 0 ELSE DT.VOYAGE_CHECK_LT END + DT.SHIP_LT_TOTAL + DT.OSP_LT) * -1, DT.SHIP_PLAN_CAL),112)  AS CIQ_DATE

FROM   (
        SELECT 
               A.DIVISION_ID , A.DEPT_NAME_KO , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE , A.PROJECT_NAME , A.PROJECT_OWNER ,A.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, A.ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.DUE_DATE_MKT , A.QTY , A.ENERGY , A.CELL_QUANTITY
             , A.BOD_ID , A.DAYS_MON, A.DAYS_TUE, A.DAYS_WED, A.DAYS_THU, A.DAYS_FRI, A.DAYS_SAT, A.DAYS_SUN
             , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND , A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING , A.LT_VOYAGE , A.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
             , A.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN , A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL , A.LT_TOTAL
             , A.LT_INLAND , A.GAP_LT, ISNULL(LT.LT_DAY,0) AS OSP_LT
             , DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT)) AS SHIP_PLAN_CAL
             , DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) AS DAY_IDX
             , CASE --  ① 일요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 1
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ② 월요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 2
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ③ 화요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 3
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                         END END END END END END END 
                    --  ④ 수요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 4
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑤ 목요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 5
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑥ 금요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 6
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    --  ⑦ 토요일인 경우 --------------------------------------------------------
                    WHEN DATEPART(DW, DATEADD(DD, A.GAP_LT * -1, CONVERT(DATE, A.DUE_DATE_MKT))) = 7
                    THEN CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SAT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_FRI = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_THU = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_WED = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_TUE = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYS_MON = 'Y' THEN 5 ELSE 
                         CASE WHEN A.DAYS_SUN = 'Y' THEN 6 ELSE 0 
                    END END END END END END END 
                    ELSE 0
               END  AS VOYAGE_CHECK_LT
         , A.BOD_VALID_YN
        FROM   (
 
                SELECT MK.DIVISION_ID , MK.DEPT_NAME_KO , MK.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , MK.SCM_SITE_ID , MK.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , MK.PROJECT_CODE , MK.PROJECT_NAME , MK.PROJECT_OWNER ,MK.PROJECT_OWNER_KO, MK.ITEM_ID
                     , MK.ITEM_NAME , MK.FCST_TYPE , MK.INCOTERMS , MK.DUE_DATE_MKT , MK.QTY , MK.ENERGY , MK.CELL_QUANTITY
                     , BD.BOD_ID , BD.DAYS_MON, BD.DAYS_TUE, BD.DAYS_WED, BD.DAYS_THU, BD.DAYS_FRI, BD.DAYS_SAT, BD.DAYS_SUN
                     , BD.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND , BD.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING , BD.LT_VOYAGE , BD.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                     , BD.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, BD.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN , BD.SHIP_LT_TOTAL , BD.LT_TOTAL
                     , BD.LT_INLAND , BD.GAP_LT, BD.BOD_VALID_YN
                FROM   (
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , C.DEPT_NAME_KO , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , PR.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE , D.PROJECT_NAME , D.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , (
                                SELECT Z.USER_NAME
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO Z WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
                               ) AS PROJECT_OWNER_KO
                             , A.ITEM_ID , IT.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.YYYYMMDD  AS DUE_DATE_MKT
                             , A.QTY , IT.ENERGE  AS ENERGY , IT.CELL_QUANTITY
                        FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C A WITH(NOLOCK)
                               LEFT OUTER JOIN
                               (
                                SELECT PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY PR
                                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = '82'
                                AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                --AND    CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) BETWEEN FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TO_YYYYMMDD
                                AND TO_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)
                                AND    (PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-P' OR PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-A')
                                GROUP  BY PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                               ) PR
                               ON  A.DIVISION_ID = PR.DIVISION_ID
                               AND A.ITEM_ID     = PR.ITEM_ID
                             , SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SITE E WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , [DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] IT WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = '82'
                        AND    A.VERSION_NO = SUBSTRING(@PARAM_VERSION_NO, 1, 18)    
                        AND    A.MEASURE     IN ('MKT_FCST', 'AS_In_Req')
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
                        AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID  = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = IT.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID     = IT.ITEM_ID
                        AND    IT.ITEM_TYPE  = 'P'
                        AND    A.QTY         > 0
                        AND    E.VMI_YN      = 'N'
                        AND    A.YYYYMMDD    >= substring(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112), 1, 6 ) + '01'                   
                        AND  (@PARAM_ITEM_ID = '' OR A.ITEM_ID = @PARAM_ITEM_ID)                        
                        AND  (@PARAM_PROJECT_CODE = '' OR A.PROJECT_CODE = @PARAM_PROJECT_CODE)
                        UNION  ALL

                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , C.DEPT_NAME_KO , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER , A.SCM_SITE_ID , PR.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE , D.PROJECT_NAME , D.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , (
                                SELECT Z.USER_NAME
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO Z WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
                               ) AS PROJECT_OWNER_KO
                             , A.ITEM_ID , IT.ITEM_NAME , A.FCST_TYPE , A.INCOTERMS , A.YYYYMMDD  AS DUE_DATE_MKT
                             , A.QTY , IT.ENERGE  AS ENERGY , IT.CELL_QUANTITY
                        FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C A WITH(NOLOCK)
                               LEFT OUTER JOIN
                               (
                                SELECT PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                                FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY PR
                                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = '82'
                                AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                --AND    CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) BETWEEN FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TO_YYYYMMDD
                                AND TO_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)
                                AND    (PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-P' OR PLANT_SITE_ID LIKE '%-A')
                                GROUP  BY PR.DIVISION_ID, PR.PLANT_SITE_ID, PR.ITEM_ID
                               ) PR
                               ON  A.DIVISION_ID = PR.DIVISION_ID
                               AND A.ITEM_ID     = PR.ITEM_ID
                             , SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , SCM_MST_SITE E WITH(NOLOCK)
                             , [DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] IT WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = '82'                        
                        AND    A.VERSION_NO = SUBSTRING(@PARAM_VERSION_NO, 1, 18)    
                        AND    A.MEASURE     = 'VMI_In_Req'
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
                        AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID  = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = IT.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID     = IT.ITEM_ID
                        AND    IT.ITEM_TYPE  = 'P'
                        AND    A.QTY         > 0
                        AND    A.YYYYMMDD    >= substring(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112), 1, 6 ) + '01'
                        AND    E.VMI_YN      = 'Y'
                        AND  (@PARAM_ITEM_ID = '' OR A.ITEM_ID = @PARAM_ITEM_ID)                        
                        AND  (@PARAM_PROJECT_CODE = '' OR A.PROJECT_CODE = @PARAM_PROJECT_CODE)
                       ) MK
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN 
                       (
                       SELECT DISTINCT
                              A.BOD_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.INCOTERMS, B.ITEM_ID
                            , A.DAYS_MON, A.DAYS_TUE, A.DAYS_WED, A.DAYS_THU, A.DAYS_FRI, A.DAYS_SAT, A.DAYS_SUN
                            , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, A.LT_VOYAGE, A.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                            , A.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN, A.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, A.LT_TOTAL
                            , A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING AS LT_INLAND
                            , CASE WHEN A.LT_TOTAL <= A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
                                   THEN 0
                                   ELSE A.LT_TOTAL - (A.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND + A.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING)
                              END  AS GAP_LT
                            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.INCOTERMS, B.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.PRIORITY, A.LT_TOTAL DESC, A.BOD_ID) AS BOD_PRIORITY
		  , VALID_YN AS BOD_VALID_YN
                       FROM   SCP_MST_BOD_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
                            , SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM B WITH(NOLOCK)
                       WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID     = '82'
                       AND    A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND    A.BOD_ID          = B.BOD_ID
                       AND    A.BOD_VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                       --AND    B.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                       ) BD
                       ON  MK.DIVISION_ID = BD.DIVISION_ID
                       AND MK.SCM_SITE_ID = BD.TO_SITE
                       AND MK.PLANT_SITE_ID = BD.FROM_SITE
                       AND MK.INCOTERMS     = BD.INCOTERMS
                       AND MK.ITEM_ID       = BD.ITEM_ID
                       AND BD.BOD_PRIORITY  = 1            

               ) A
               LEFT OUTER JOIN
               SCP_MST_OPERATION_LT LT WITH(NOLOCK)
               ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = LT.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID   = LT.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID         = LT.ITEM_ID
               AND LT.LT_OPERATION   = 'OSP_LT'
       ) DT
 WHERE ISNULL(DT.BOD_VALID_YN,'Y') = 'Y'
--ORDER  BY 1,3,4,5

SELECT DISTINCT
		 t.division_id
        ,dbo.fn_get_division_name(t.division_id) AS division_name
		,t.scm_site_id 
		,t.project_code
		,t.item_id 
		,CASE WHEN  u.plant_per_item is null  THEN 'BOM Not Exists' ELSE  u.plant_per_item END AS plant_per_item 
		,isnull(u.cmpltd_status,'N') AS cmpltd_status
		--,substring(yyyymmdd,1,6) AS month 
		--,t.qty
	--INTO #TblDynamicPivot_SCP0006_01
	FROM ( select distinct a.division_id,project_code,a.scm_site_id,a.item_id,dom_exp,fcst_type,incoterms,measure,plant_site_id,yyyymmdd,qty 
	         from dm_pln_mkt_fcst a 
			 JOIN scm_mst_item_sn b ON a.division_id = b.division_id and a.item_id= b.item_id
			 LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site s ON s.DIVISION_ID=a.DIVISION_ID AND s.SCM_SITE_ID=a.SCM_SITE_ID AND s.VMI_YN='Y'
	        WHERE 1=1 
			  --AND a.measure ='MKT_FCST'
			  AND a.MEASURE = IIF( ISNULL(s.vmi_yn, 'N') = 'Y', 'VMI_In_Req',  'MKT_FCST')
			  AND b.scp_operation_group_id <> 'E'
			  AND a.yyyymmdd >= '20210329'
			  AND a.yyyymmdd <= '20220430'
			  and a.yyyymmdd != '' and a.yyyymmdd is not null

			union all

		   select distinct a.division_id,project_code,a.scm_site_id,a.item_id,dom_exp,fcst_type,incoterms,measure,plant_site_id,yyyymmdd,qty 
	         from dbo.DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT a 
	         JOIN scm_mst_item_sn b ON a.division_id = b.division_id and a.item_id= b.item_id
			 LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site s ON s.DIVISION_ID=a.DIVISION_ID AND s.SCM_SITE_ID=a.SCM_SITE_ID AND s.VMI_YN='Y'
	        WHERE 1=1 
			  --AND a.measure ='MKT_FCST'
			  AND a.MEASURE = IIF( ISNULL(s.vmi_yn, 'N') = 'Y', 'VMI_In_Req',  'MKT_FCST')
			  AND b.scp_operation_group_id <> 'E'
			  AND a.yyyymmdd >= '20210329'
			  AND a.yyyymmdd <= '20220430'
			  and a.yyyymmdd != '' and a.yyyymmdd is not null			  	
	     ) t  

		 /*******************start of 수량 카운트 부분 ********************************************************************************/
		 LEFT OUTER JOIN  (SELECT division_id
								 ,SCM_SITE_ID
		                         ,project_code								 
								 ,model_id
								 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SUM(plant_cnt) ) +'/'+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, tot_cnt) AS plant_per_item
								 ,CASE WHEN SUM(plant_cnt) = tot_cnt THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END cmpltd_status
							FROM (
								SELECT division_id,SCM_SITE_ID, project_code, model_id, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY division_id,SCM_SITE_ID,project_code,model_id) AS tot_cnt, CASE WHEN primary_plant IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS plant_cnt
								FROM (
										SELECT DISTINCT	
										         (CASE 
												  WHEN dbo.FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(a.division_id, a.item_id) = 'E' THEN C.ITEM_ID
												  ELSE b.model_id	
												  END ) AS model_id	
											   , (CASE 
												  -- 전극 제외 20180517
												  --WHEN d.operation_group_id = 'E' THEN 'Electrode'
												  WHEN d.operation_group_id = 'A' THEN 'Cell'
												  WHEN d.operation_group_id = 'P' THEN 'Pack'
												  END ) AS operation_group_id
											   ,d.electrode_type
											   ,b.child_item_id AS item_id
											  ,(SELECT rownumber 
												 FROM (		
														SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY from_yyyymmdd) AS rownumber
												 		 FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority s 
														WHERE s.division_id   = b.division_id
														  AND s.item_id       = b.child_item_id 
														  AND s.project_code  = a.project_code
														  AND s.SALES_SITE_ID = a.SCM_SITE_ID /* 20180326 sales site 추가부분 */
														  AND s.to_yyyymmdd  >= convert(varchar, getdate(),112) 
														  AND s.valid_yn = 'Y'
														  AND s.priority = '1'
	 													) a 
												 WHERE rownumber =1
												) AS primary_plant
											 ,b.division_id
											 ,a.SCM_SITE_ID
											 ,a.project_code			
										FROM dm_pln_mkt_fcst a 
											JOIN scm_mst_bom_sn b    ON a.division_id   = b.division_id
																	and a.item_id       = b.model_id 	
											JOIN scm_mst_item_sn c   ON b.company_id    = c.company_id 
																	and b.division_id   = c.division_id	
																	and b.site_id       = c.site_id 
																	and b.child_item_id = c.item_id
											JOIN scm_mst_final_item_v d  ON b.division_id = d.division_id  and b.child_item_id = d.item_id
											LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site s ON s.DIVISION_ID=a.DIVISION_ID AND s.SCM_SITE_ID=a.SCM_SITE_ID AND s.VMI_YN='Y'
										WHERE 1=1
										--AND c.item_type		<> 'r'
										--  실적(등록된 카운트)수량은 분기되기 이전 날짜 전체를 사용해야 카운트가 맞음
										--Alternate Part 제외로직 추가
										AND	b.alt_priority ='Y'
										AND a.yyyymmdd >= '20210329'
										AND a.yyyymmdd <= '20220430'
									 	--AND a.measure ='MKT_FCST'
										AND a.MEASURE = IIF( ISNULL(s.vmi_yn, 'N') = 'Y', 'VMI_In_Req',  'MKT_FCST')
			  							AND a.qty>0	
										AND a.division_id  = '81'
										AND d.OPERATION_GROUP_ID <> 'E'
										--팩모델 하위의 CELL중에서 일부가 자동차전지에만 BOM에서 모ITEM으로 존재하지만,PROJECT ROUTE화면에서 ESS에 생산지를 등록하도록 표기되는 오류수정
										AND EXISTS (SELECT *
													FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN] WITH(NOLOCK)
												   WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81'
													 AND PARENT_ITEM_ID= b.child_item_id
													--BOM을 제거모델 조회안되도록 수정
													AND EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
													AND KEY_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(KEY_DATE)
																	 FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN] WITH(NOLOCK)
																    WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID= b.child_item_id --'ECE0315N1-01'
																 	  AND DIVISION_ID = '81' )
												   )
									) m
								) n
							GROUP BY division_id, SCM_SITE_ID,project_code, model_id, tot_cnt
						) u  ON t.division_id  = u.division_id
						    AND t.SCM_SITE_ID  = u.SCM_SITE_ID
						    AND t.project_code = u.project_code
						    AND t.item_id      = u.model_id
		/******************end of 수량카운트********************************************************************************************/

		 INNER JOIN  scm_mst_site_item v  ON t.division_id  = v.division_id 
										and t.item_id      = v.item_id
										and t.scm_site_id  = v.scm_site_id 
										and t.project_code = v.project_code
         INNER JOIN  (SELECT division_id
		   				    ,item_id
		   				    ,nick_name
		   					,item_type
		   					,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY division_id, item_id ORDER BY  CASE item_type WHEN 'P' THEN 999 WHEN 'H' THEN 888 WHEN 'R' THEN 777  WHEN 'Q' THEN 666 ELSE 0 END  DESC ) nums
					   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN 
					   ) i   ON t.division_id  = i.division_id
						    AND t.item_id      = i.item_id
							AND i.nums =1
	WHERE 1=1
	  AND i.item_type NOT IN ('Q','R')	
	  --AND t.measure ='MKT_FCST'
	  AND t.measure in ('VMI_In_Req',  'MKT_FCST')
	  AND t.qty>0	
		AND t.division_id  = '81'

and isnull(u.cmpltd_status,'N') = 'N'

DQ_NAME: No Line Assign With Prod Plan
DESCRIPTION: 생산계획 있는데 Lign Assign 안 된 모델 조회
DQ_TEXT:
SELECT DISTINCT A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, PROD_MONTH
FROM   (
		SELECT A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, LEFT(A.YYYYMMDD, 6) AS PROD_MONTH, A.QTY
		FROM   SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE  1=1

		AND    DIVISION_ID         = @PARAM_DIVSION_ID
		AND    PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PARAM_PLAN_YYYYMMDD
		AND    PLAN_TYPE           = @PARAM_PLAN_TYPE
		AND    SEQ                 = @PARAM_PLAN_SEQ
		
		AND    QTY                 > 0
		AND    MEASURE             = 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'
		AND    OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WITH(NOLOCK)   
                                WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 
								AND    segment3 = CASE WHEN @PARAM_DIVSION_ID = 'EE' THEN 'E'
								                       ELSE segment3
												  END
						       )
		AND    NOT EXISTS (
							SELECT 1
							FROM   (
									SELECT *
									FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN C WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE  1=1
									AND    C.OPERATION_ID  IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                                               FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WITH(NOLOCK)   
                                                               WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 
								                               AND    segment3 = CASE WHEN @PARAM_DIVSION_ID = 'EE' THEN 'E'
								                                                      ELSE segment3
												                                 END
															  )
									AND    C.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0', '9')
								 ) B
							WHERE  1=1
							AND    A.LINE_ID           = B.LINE_ID
							AND    A.OPERATION_ID      = B.OPERATION_ID
							AND    A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
							AND    LEFT(A.YYYYMMDD, 6) = B.MONTH
							)
	) A

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.PLAN_TYPE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.SALES_SITE_ID
     , A.MODEL_ID
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , A.QTY                          AS FCST_QTY
     , B.PLANNED_QTY                  AS PLANNED_QTY
     , A.QTY- ISNULL(B.PLANNED_QTY,0) AS UNPLAN_QTY
FROM   SCP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_DEMAND A WITH(NOLOCK)
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                   SELECT A.ENG_DEMAND_ID
                        , A.ITEM_ID
                        , A.TO_SITE
                        , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.DUE_DATE, 112) AS YYYYMMDD
                        , A.REQUIRED_QTY
                        , ROUND(A.PLANNED_QTY,0)            AS PLANNED_QTY
                   FROM   SCP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_PEGGING A WITH(NOLOCK)
                   WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID            = @PARAM_DIVSION_ID
                   AND    A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    = @PARAM_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND    A.PLAN_TYPE              = @PARAM_PLAN_TYPE
                   AND    A.SEQ                    = @PARAM_PLAN_SEQ 
                   AND    A.PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE = 'ALLOC'
                  ) B
  ON  (A.ENG_DEMAND_ID = B.ENG_DEMAND_ID)
WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID         = @PARAM_DIVSION_ID
AND    A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PARAM_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
AND    A.PLAN_TYPE           = @PARAM_PLAN_TYPE
AND    A.SEQ                 = @PARAM_PLAN_SEQ 
AND    A.PROBLEM_TYPE        = 'UNPLAN'
AND   (@PARAM_SCM_SITE_ID = '' OR A.SALES_SITE_ID = @PARAM_SCM_SITE_ID)
AND   (@PARAM_ITEM_ID     = '' OR A.MODEL_ID      = @PARAM_ITEM_ID)

SELECT  
	 DIVISION_ID			AS DIV
	,FROM_SITE				AS SITE
	,ITEM_ID				AS MODEL
	,NICK_NAME				AS NICK_NAME
	,LOT_ID					AS LOT_ID
	,YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT AS D_DAY_EXPECTED
	,MES_CHANGE_STATUS		AS CHANGE_STATUS
	,LOT_TYPE				AS LOT_TYPE
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,MES_ASSY_QTY))			AS MES_ASSY_QTY
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,LOT_QTY_MES))				AS GMES_LOT_QTY
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,LOT_QTY_MES_NG))			AS GMES_LOT_NG_QTY
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,LOT_QTY_FCS))				AS FCS_LOT_QTY
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,FCS_SPECIAL_QTY))			AS SPECIAL_LOT_QTY
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,OWMS_STOCK_QTY))			AS OWMS_STOCK_QTY
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(INT,OWMS_RESULT_QTY))			AS OWMS_SHIP_QTY
    ,USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE	AS USER_MODIFIED_RELEASE_DATE
    ,AVAILABLE_YN			AS AVAILABLE_STOCK_YN
    ,MES_HOLD_YN			AS MES_HOLD_YN
    ,QMS_HOLD_YN			AS QMS_HOLD_YN
    ,FCS_HOLD_YN			AS FCS_HOLD_YN
    ,REMARKS				AS REMARKS
    ,JUDG_VLD_DATE			AS JUDGE_VAILD_DATE
    ,MES_HOLD_RELEASE		AS MES_UNHOLD_SCHED_DATE
    ,QMS_HOLD_RELEASE		AS QMS_UNHOLD_SCHED_DATE
    ,LAST_UPDATED_BY		AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, LAST_UPDATE_DATE,120)		AS LAST_UPDATED_DATE
FROM
(
	SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.DIVISION_ID,T1.FROM_SITE,T1.ITEM_ID,T1.LOT_ID ORDER BY T1.LOT_TYPE DESC,T1.MES_CHANGE_STATUS DESC) AS ROWNUM
		,T1.DIVISION_ID		
		,T1.FROM_SITE		
		,T1.ITEM_ID			
		,T1.NICK_NAME		
		,T1.LOT_ID			
		,T1.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT 
		,T1.MES_CHANGE_STATUS
		,T1.LOT_TYPE
		,T1.LOT_QTY_MES
		,T1.LOT_QTY_FCS
		,T1.FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
		,T1.OWMS_STOCK_QTY
		,T1.LOT_QTY_TOT
		,T1.AVAILABLE_YN
		,T1.MES_HOLD_YN
		,T1.QMS_HOLD_YN
		,T1.FCS_HOLD_YN
		,T1.LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
		,T1.JUDG_VLD_DATE
		,T1.MES_HOLD_RELEASE
		,T1.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
		,T1.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
		,T1.REMARKS
		,T1.LAST_UPDATED_BY
		,T1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
		,T1.MES_ASSY_QTY
		,T1.OWMS_RESULT_QTY
		,T1.LOT_QTY_MES_NG
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
				X.DIVISION_ID
				,X.FROM_SITE
				,X.ITEM_ID
				,DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(X.DIVISION_ID, X.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
				--,SUBSTRING(X.LOT_ID,0,9) AS LOT_ID
				,X.LOT_ID AS LOT_ID
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),X.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT))) AS YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
				,X.CHANGE_STATUS AS MES_CHANGE_STATUS
				,X.LOT_TYPE
				,X.LOT_QTY_MES
				,X.LOT_QTY_FCS
				,X.FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
				,X.OWMS_STOCK_QTY
				,X.LOT_QTY_TOT   AS LOT_QTY_TOT
				,X.AVAILABLE_YN
				,X.MES_HOLD_YN
				,X.QMS_HOLD_YN
				,X.FCS_HOLD_YN
				,X.LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, CASE X.JUDG_VLD_DATE WHEN '-' THEN NULL ELSE X.JUDG_VLD_DATE END,112), 23) AS JUDG_VLD_DATE
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, CASE X.MES_HOLD_RELEASE WHEN '-' THEN NULL ELSE X.MES_HOLD_RELEASE END,112), 23) AS MES_HOLD_RELEASE
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, CASE X.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE WHEN '-' THEN NULL ELSE X.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE END,112 ), 23) AS QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, CASE X.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE WHEN '' THEN NULL ELSE X.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE END ,112), 23) AS USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
				,X.REMARKS
				,CASE WHEN 'KO' = 'KO' THEN U.USERNAME ELSE U.USERNAME_E END + '(' + X.LAST_UPDATED_BY + ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
				,X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				,ISNULL(A.MES_ASSY_QTY, 0)		AS MES_ASSY_QTY
				,ISNULL(W.OWMS_RESULT_QTY, 0)	AS OWMS_RESULT_QTY
				,ISNULL(X.ATTRIBUTE4, 0)        AS LOT_QTY_MES_NG
			FROM SSP_ANL_MES_FCS_STOCK_40_C AS X WITH(NOLOCK)
				    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, LOT_ID, SUM(WIPQTY2_ED) AS MES_ASSY_QTY
									FROM [DBO].[SSP_DNM_MES_WIP_HISTORY] WITH(NOLOCK)
                                    GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, LOT_ID) AS A
				ON X.DIVISION_ID	= A.DIVISION_ID 
				AND X.FROM_SITE	= A.FROM_SITE
				AND X.ITEM_ID		= A.ITEM_ID
				AND X.LOT_ID		= A.LOT_ID
				    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, SUBSTRING(LOT_ID,1,8) AS LOT_ID, SUM(LOT_QTY) AS OWMS_RESULT_QTY
                                    FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
                                    GROUP BY 
									        DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, SUBSTRING(LOT_ID,1,8)
                                    ) AS W
				ON X.DIVISION_ID	= W.DIVISION_ID 
				AND X.FROM_SITE	= W.FROM_SITE
				AND X.ITEM_ID		= W.ITEM_ID
				AND X.LOT_ID		= W.LOT_ID
				    LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FX_USER U 
				ON X.LAST_UPDATED_BY = U.USERID 
				AND U.USEYN = 'Y'
			WHERE X.DIVISION_ID = N'40' 
				AND X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD	= N'20210721' 
				AND ( ( N'G182-A'    IS NULL OR N'G182-A'  ='')  OR X.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'G182-A' ,',')) )
				AND ( ( N''    IS NULL OR N''  ='')  OR X.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'' ,',')) )
				AND ( ( N''    IS NULL OR N''  ='')  OR X.LOT_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'' ,',')) )
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
					A.DIVISION_ID
				,A.FROM_SITE 
				,A.ITEM_ID
				,DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID ) AS NICK_NAME
				,SUBSTRING(A.LOT_ID,0,9) AS LOT_ID
				,NULL   AS YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
				,NULL AS MES_CHANGE_STATUS
				,NULL AS LOT_TYPE
				,0 AS LOT_QTY_MES
				,0 AS LOT_QTY_FCS
				,0 AS FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
				,SUM(A.STOCK_QTY) AS OWMS_STOCK_QTY
				,0 AS LOT_QTY_TOT
				,'-' AS AVAILABLE_YN
				,'-' AS MES_HOLD_YN
				,'-' AS QMS_HOLD_YN
				,'-' AS FCS_HOLD_YN
				,'-' AS LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
				,NULL AS JUDG_VLD_DATE
				,NULL AS MES_HOLD_RELEASE
				,NULL AS QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
				,NULL AS USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
				,NULL AS REMARKS
				,NULL AS LAST_UPDATE_BY
				,NULL AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				,0		AS MES_ASSY_QTY
				,SUM(ISNULL(W.OWMS_RESULT_QTY, 0))		AS OWMS_RESULT_QTY
				,0      AS LOT_QTY_MES_NG
			FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A WITH(NOLOCK)
					LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SLOC B 
				ON B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID  
				AND B.STORAGE_ID = A.STORAGE_ID 
				AND B.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
				    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, SUBSTRING(LOT_ID,1,8) AS LOT_ID, SUM(LOT_QTY) AS OWMS_RESULT_QTY
                                    FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
                                    GROUP BY 
									        DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, SUBSTRING(LOT_ID,1,8)
                                    ) AS W
				ON A.DIVISION_ID	= W.DIVISION_ID 
				AND A.FROM_SITE	= W.FROM_SITE
				AND A.ITEM_ID		= W.ITEM_ID
				AND A.LOT_ID		= W.LOT_ID
		WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = N'40' 
			AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = N'20210721' 
			AND ( ( N'G182-A'    IS NULL OR N'G182-A'  ='')  OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'G182-A' ,',')) )
			AND ( ( N''    IS NULL OR N''  ='')  OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'' ,',')) )
			AND ( ( N''    IS NULL OR N''  ='')  OR A.LOT_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(N'' ,',')) )
			GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
					,A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
					,A.FROM_SITE 
					,A.ITEM_ID
					,SUBSTRING(A.LOT_ID,0,9)
	) T1
) T2
WHERE T2.ROWNUM = 1

SELECT 
       BB.[PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD]
      ,BB.[PROJECT_CODE] 
      ,BB.[ITEM_ID]
	  ,(SELECT TOP 1 NICK_NAME   
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B  WITH (NOLOCK)  
         WHERE BB.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL 
          ) AS NICK_NAME 
      ,BB.[TO_SITE]
	  ,BB.[REQ_M0]
	  ,BB.[REQ_M1]
	  ,BB.[REQ_M2]
	  ,BB.[REQ_M3]
	  ,BB.[REQ_M4]
	  ,BB.[PLAN_M0]

SELECT 
 BB.DIVISION_ID
,BB.YYYYMMDD
,BB.ITEM_ID
,BB.FROM_SITE
,BB.ERP
,BB.OWMS
,BB.GAP

  FROM (
         SELECT 
                 AA.DIVISION_ID
                ,AA.YYYYMMDD
                ,AA.ITEM_ID
                ,AA.FROM_SITE
                ,SUM(CASE AA.TYPE WHEN 'ERP' THEN AA.QTY ELSE 0  END) AS 'ERP'
                ,SUM(CASE AA.TYPE WHEN 'OWMS' THEN AA.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS 'OWMS'
                ,SUM(CASE AA.TYPE WHEN 'ERP' THEN AA.QTY ELSE 0  END) - SUM(CASE AA.TYPE WHEN 'OWMS' THEN AA.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS 'GAP'
           FROM 
   (    SELECT  
         E.DIVISION_ID         AS DIVISION_ID
        , 'ERP'                AS TYPE
        ,E.CONFIRM_ID          AS CONFIRM_ID
        ,E.ORDER_NO            AS ERP_SO_NO 
        ,E.EXFACTORY_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
        ,E.TRANSPORT_MODE      AS TRANSPORT_MODE
        ,E.INCOTERMS           AS INCOTERMS
        ,E.ETA_DATE            AS ETA_DATE
        ,E.ETD_DATE            AS ETD_DATE
        ,E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID    AS FROM_SITE
        ,E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID      AS TO_SITE
        ,E.ITEM_ID             AS ITEM_ID
        ,SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY ) AS QTY 
        FROM [DBO].[SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT] E WITH(NOLOCK)
            JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE' -- LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 
            AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.SSP_TYPE
        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE AS S WITH(NOLOCK)                     
            ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID    = S.SCM_SITE_ID                 
           AND E.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID                 
           AND S.SITE_TYPE        = 'PLANT'                                      
        JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN AS T WITH(NOLOCK)                 
            ON E.ITEM_ID        = T.ITEM_ID                     
           AND E.DIVISION_ID    = T.DIVISION_ID                 
           AND S.COMPANY_ID        = T.COMPANY_ID                 
           AND T.ITEM_TYPE        NOT IN ('Q','R')
        WHERE 1=1
        AND   ISNULL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10') -- D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 
        AND   E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
        AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD 
                
        GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID 
        ,        E.CONFIRM_ID
        ,        E.ORDER_NO
        ,        E.EXFACTORY_DATE
        ,        E.TRANSPORT_MODE
        ,        E.INCOTERMS        
        ,         E.ETA_DATE        
        ,         E.ETD_DATE
        ,         E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID    
        ,         E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID    
        ,         E.ITEM_ID
        -- )
    -- , RESULT_ERP_C_NON AS 
    -- (
   UNION ALL 
        -- ERP 출하실적에서 CONFIRM_ID 없는 실적 
        SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
        ,        'ERP'                      AS TYPE
        ,       '-'                       AS CONFIRM_ID
        ,       E.ORDER_NO                  AS ERP_SO_NO 
        ,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
        ,       E.TRANSPORT_MODE          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
        ,       E.INCOTERMS                  AS INCOTERMS
        ,        E.ETA_DATE                  AS ETA_DATE
        ,        E.ETD_DATE                  AS ETD_DATE
        ,       E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE                                                                    
        ,       ISNULL(L3.SEGMENT4, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID)     AS TO_SITE   
        ,       E.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
        ,       SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY )     AS QTY  
        FROM [DBO].[SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT] E WITH(NOLOCK)
        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE AS S WITH(NOLOCK)                     
            ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID    = S.SCM_SITE_ID                 
           AND E.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID                 
           AND S.SITE_TYPE        = 'PLANT'                                      
        JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN AS T WITH(NOLOCK)                 
            ON E.ITEM_ID        = T.ITEM_ID                     
           AND E.DIVISION_ID    = T.DIVISION_ID                 
           AND S.COMPANY_ID        = T.COMPANY_ID                 
           AND T.ITEM_TYPE        NOT IN ('Q','R')
        JOIN  SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F WITH(NOLOCK) -- SCP 대상 ITEM만 
            ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID 
            AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE FS WITH(NOLOCK)
            ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID 
           AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID 
           -- AND ISNULL(FS.OSP_YN,'N') <> 'Y' --- [C20200121-000352]-2 : FROM_SITE PACKER포함(OSP_YN <> 'Y' 조건제외)
           -- 2020.09.18 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석처리
           -- 2021.04.15 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석해제
        JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WITH(NOLOCK)
            ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_ORDER_TYPE' -- LOOKUP에 등록된 ORDER_TYPE만 대상으로 함 
        AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
        AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE     
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3 WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING' --SOLDTO, SHIPTO 과 MAPPING되는 TO_SITE 
            AND L3.SEGMENT1    = E.DIVISION_ID 
            AND L3.SEGMENT2    = E.SOLDTO_CODE
            AND L3.SEGMENT3    = E.SHIPTO_CODE                        
        WHERE 1=1
        AND   ISNULL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10') -- D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 
        AND   ISNULL(E.CONFIRM_ID,'') NOT LIKE  'C%'
        AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN  @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD 
        AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN ('6000' ,'799A') --상품창고제외 
        AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 
                                FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL 
                                WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
                                    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                )    -- 사외 창고 제외 LOOKUP 관리
        GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID
        ,        E.ORDER_NO
        ,        E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID                                                                           
        ,        ISNULL(L3.SEGMENT4, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID) 
        ,        E.ITEM_ID
        ,        E.EXFACTORY_DATE
        ,        E.TRANSPORT_MODE
        ,        E.INCOTERMS        
        ,         E.ETA_DATE        
        ,         E.ETD_DATE
        ,         E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID    
        ,         E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID    
    UNION ALL 
        -- OWMS 출하실적/반품 [C20191205-000132]
    SELECT     R.DIVISION_ID      AS DIVISION_ID
        ,        'OWMS'              AS TYPE
        ,      '-'                AS CONFIRM_ID
        ,      '-'                AS ERP_SO_NO
        ,      R.YYYYMMDD         AS YYYYMMDD
        ,      R.YYYYMMDD         AS TRANSPORT_MODE
        ,      '-'                  AS INCOTERMS
        ,      NULL                  AS ETA_DATE
        ,      NULL                  AS ETD_DATE
        ,      R.FROM_SITE        AS FROM_SITE 
        ,      R.TO_SITE          AS TO_SITE 
        ,      R.ITEM_ID          AS ITEM_ID 
        ,      R.QTY              AS QTY 
        --,       R.SHIP_TYPE          AS SHIP_TYPE
        FROM  SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE R.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN  @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD 
) AA
WHERE 1 = 1 
 AND FROM_SITE NOT LIKE ('%-E')
GROUP BY 
 AA.DIVISION_ID

,AA.ITEM_ID
,AA.FROM_SITE) BB

               CASE WHEN c.level_2_code = 'RCA'   THEN 1
			        WHEN c.level_3_code = 'MFLCU' THEN 2
					WHEN c.level_2_code = 'RAA'   THEN 3
					WHEN c.level_3_code = 'MFLAL' THEN 4
					WHEN c.level_2_code = 'RSE'   THEN 5
					WHEN c.level_2_code in ('RETCY', 'RETRA', 'RETPM') THEN 6
					WHEN c.level_2_code = 'MIL'   THEN 7
					WHEN c.level_2_code = 'MAL'   THEN 8
					WHEN c.level_2_code = 'MPU'   THEN 9
               ELSE 99
               END AS seq
		FROM   scm_mst_bom_sn_V a, scm_item_m_sn b, SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_SN c
		WHERE  1=1
		AND    a.division_id   = b.division_id

		AND    a.child_item_id = b.item_id
		AND    b.item_class    = c.class_id
		AND    b.item_type     = 'R'

		AND   (@PARAM_ITEM_ID = '' OR A.MODEL_ID = @PARAM_ITEM_ID) 
		AND   (@PARAM_SITE_ID = '' OR a.site_id = @PARAM_SITE_ID)

		AND    c.level_2_code IN ('RCA', 'MFL', 'RAA', 'RSE', 'MIL' , 'MAL', 'MPU')
       ) a
       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM b
WHERE  1=1
AND    A.model_id = B.ITEM_ID

     , P.PLAN_TYPE
     , P.PLAN_SEQ	 
     , CASE WHEN INT.INCOTERMS <> INT.ATTRIBUTE1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INC_DIFF
     , INT.ORG_TO_SCM_SITE_ID AS SCM_SITE_ID 
	 , INT.ITEM_ID
	 , INT.ETA_DATE
	 , INT.INCOTERMS
	 , INT.ATTRIBUTE1 AS ORG_INCOTERMS
	 , SUM(INT.DELIVERY_QTY) AS DELIVERY_QTY
FROM   SCP_ENG_INTRANSITSHPMNT_I_SN INT WITH(NOLOCK)
       JOIN SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V P WITH(NOLOCK)
	   ON  INT.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
	   AND INT.PLAN_ID     = P.PLAN_ID
	   AND INT.PLAN_TYPE   = P.PLAN_TYPE
	   AND INT.PLAN_SEQ    = P.PLAN_SEQ
