SELECT     X.DIVISION_ID 
	,      MS.COMPANY_ID AS COMPANY_ID
	,	   X.ERP_SO_NO
	,      X.ERP_DO_NO
	,      X.CONFIRM_ID 
	,      X.ITEM_ID 
	,      DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(X.DIVISION_ID, X.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME	
	,      ISNULL(DBO.FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(X.DIVISION_ID,X.FROM_SITE),X.FROM_SITE)   AS FROM_SITE 
	,      ISNULL(DBO.FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(X.DIVISION_ID,X.TO_SITE),X.TO_SITE)       AS TO_SITE 		
	,      X.END_CUSTOMER  
	,      X.QTY AS RESULT_ERP
	,      X.WQTY AS RESULT_OWMS
	,      X.QTY - X.WQTY AS GAP
	,      ISNULL(MS.OSP_YN,'N')  AS PACKER_YN
	,      X.NORMAL_YN 
	,      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, X.YYYYMMDD,112), 23) AS YYYYMMDD 
	,      X.TRANSPORT_MODE
	,      X.INCOTERMS
	,      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, X.ETD_DATE,112), 23) AS ETD_DATE
	,      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, X.ETA_DATE,112), 23) AS ETA_DATE
	,	   X.SHIP_TYPE	
	FROM (		
		SELECT R.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
		,     'E'				 AS TYPE 
		,      R.ERP_SO_NO       AS ERP_SO_NO
		,      R.ERP_DO_NO       AS ERP_DO_NO
		,      R.CONFIRM_ID      AS CONFIRM_ID 
		,      R.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID 
		,      R.FROM_SITE       AS FROM_SITE 
		,      R.TO_SITE         AS TO_SITE 
		,      NULL              AS END_CUSTOMER
		,      SUM(R.RESULT_QTY)      AS QTY 
		,      R.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD
		--,      P.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		--,      P.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS
		,      R.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,      R.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS
		,      R.ETD_DATE        AS ETD_DATE
		,      R.ETA_DATE        AS ETA_DATE
		,      CASE WHEN R.ERP_DO_NO IS NULL OR R.ERP_DO_NO = '' THEN 'N' 
			        WHEN W.SHIP_TYPE IN (SELECT L1.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L1 WITH(NOLOCK)
								   WHERE L1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_TYPE' 
								   AND L1.VALID_YN = 'Y') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END  AS NORMAL_YN
		,      W.SHIP_TYPE		 AS SHIP_TYPE
		,      W.QTY             AS WQTY	
		FROM  (
				SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
				,       E.CONFIRM_ID              AS CONFIRM_ID
				,       E.ORDER_NO				  AS ERP_SO_NO 
				,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS ERP_DO_NO
				,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
				,       E.TRANSPORT_MODE		  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
				,       E.INCOTERMS				  AS INCOTERMS
				,		E.ETA_DATE				  AS ETA_DATE
				,		E.ETD_DATE				  AS ETD_DATE
				,		E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID		  AS FROM_SITE
				,		E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID		  AS TO_SITE
				,		E.ITEM_ID				  AS ITEM_ID
				,       SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY )     AS RESULT_QTY 					
				FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E WITH(NOLOCK)
					JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WITH(NOLOCK)
						ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'
					AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
					AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.SSP_TYPE 
				WHERE 1=1
				AND   ISNULL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')
				AND   E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
				AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD
				GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID 
				,        E.CONFIRM_ID
				,        E.ORDER_NO
				,        E.DELIVERY_NO
				,        E.EXFACTORY_DATE
				,		 E.TRANSPORT_MODE
				,        E.INCOTERMS
				,		 E.ETA_DATE
				,        E.ETD_DATE
				,		 E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID	
				,		 E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID	
				,		 E.ITEM_ID ) R 
				JOIN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID 
					,      A.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID 
					,      A.FROM_SITE         AS FROM_SITE
					,      CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE  A.TO_SITE END          AS TO_SITE
					,      SUM(A.LOT_QTY)            AS QTY 
					,      A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
					,	   A.SHIP_TYPE AS SHIP_TYPE
					,      A.DELIVERY_NO AS ERP_DO_NO
					FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE BETWEEN  @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD
					GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID        
					,        A.ITEM_ID      
					,        A.FROM_SITE   
					,        CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE  END  
					,        A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  
					,		 A.SHIP_TYPE
					,        A.DELIVERY_NO) W
					ON R.DIVISION_ID = W.DIVISION_ID 
					AND R.FROM_SITE = W.FROM_SITE
					AND R.ITEM_ID = W.ITEM_ID	
					AND R.ERP_DO_NO = W.ERP_DO_NO

		GROUP BY R.DIVISION_ID
		,        R.ERP_SO_NO
		,        R.ERP_DO_NO
		,        R.FROM_SITE                                                                           
		,        R.TO_SITE 
		,        R.ITEM_ID
		--,		 P.TRANSPORT_MODE			   
		--,		 P.INCOTERMS
		,		 R.TRANSPORT_MODE			   
		,		 R.INCOTERMS
		--,		 P.ETD_DATE
		--,		 P.ETA_DATE
		,		 R.ETD_DATE
		,		 R.ETA_DATE			  
		,        R.YYYYMMDD 
		,        R.CONFIRM_ID			
		,        W.QTY
		,        W.SHIP_TYPE

	UNION ALL 

		--CONFIRM_ID 없는 실적 
		SELECT R.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
		,     'E'                AS TYPE 
		,      R.ERP_SO_NO       AS ERP_SO_NO
		,      R.ERP_DO_NO       AS ERP_DO_NO
		,      NULL              AS CONFIRM_ID 
		,      R.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID 
		,      R.FROM_SITE       AS FROM_SITE 
		,      R.TO_SITE         AS TO_SITE 
		,      NULL              AS END_CUSTOMER
		,      R.QTY             AS QTY 
		,      R.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD 
		--,      NULL              AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		--,      NULL              AS INCOTERMS
		,      R.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,      R.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS
		--,      NULL              AS ETD_DATE
		--,      NULL              AS ETA_DATE
		,      R.ETD_DATE        AS ETD_DATE
		,      R.ETA_DATE        AS ETA_DATE 
		,      CASE WHEN R.ERP_DO_NO IS NULL OR R.ERP_DO_NO = '' THEN 'N' 
			        WHEN W.SHIP_TYPE IN (SELECT L1.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L1 WITH(NOLOCK)
								   WHERE L1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_TYPE' 
								   AND L1.VALID_YN = 'Y') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END  AS NORMAL_YN
		,      W.SHIP_TYPE       AS SHIP_TYPE
		,      W.QTY             AS WQTY
		FROM  (SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       '-'                       AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       E.ORDER_NO				  AS ERP_SO_NO 
		,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS ERP_DO_NO
		,       E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE                                                                    
        ,       ISNULL(L3.SEGMENT4, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID)     AS TO_SITE   
		,       E.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
		,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       E.TRANSPORT_MODE      AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       E.INCOTERMS				  AS INCOTERMS
		,		E.ETA_DATE				  AS ETA_DATE
		,		E.ETD_DATE				  AS ETD_DATE
		,       SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY )     AS QTY  		
		FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN  SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F WITH(NOLOCK) 
			  ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID 
			 AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
			JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE FS WITH(NOLOCK)
				ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID 
			   AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID 			 
			JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WITH(NOLOCK)
				ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_ORDER_TYPE'
			AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
			AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3 WITH(NOLOCK)
					ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'
				AND L3.SEGMENT1    = E.DIVISION_ID 
				AND L3.SEGMENT2    = E.SOLDTO_CODE
				AND L3.SEGMENT3    = E.SHIPTO_CODE					    
		WHERE 1=1
		AND   ISNULL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')
		AND   ISNULL(E.CONFIRM_ID,'') NOT LIKE  'C%'
		AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN  @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD		
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN ('6000' ,'799A')		
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 
								FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL 
								WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
									AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
								)
		GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID 
		,        E.ORDER_NO
		,        E.DELIVERY_NO
		,        E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID                                                                           
		,        ISNULL(L3.SEGMENT4, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID) 
		,        E.ITEM_ID   
		,        E.EXFACTORY_DATE
		,		 E.TRANSPORT_MODE
		,        E.INCOTERMS
		,		 E.ETA_DATE
		,        E.ETD_DATE	) R 
			  JOIN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID 
				,      A.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID 
				,      A.FROM_SITE         AS FROM_SITE
				,      CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE  A.TO_SITE END          AS TO_SITE
				,      SUM(A.LOT_QTY)            AS QTY 
				,      A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
				,	   A.SHIP_TYPE AS SHIP_TYPE
				,      A.DELIVERY_NO AS ERP_DO_NO
				FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE BETWEEN  @PARAM_FROM_YYYYMMDD  AND @PARAM_TO_YYYYMMDD
				GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID        
				,        A.ITEM_ID      
				,        A.FROM_SITE   
				,        CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE  END  
				,        A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  
				,		 A.SHIP_TYPE
				,        A.DELIVERY_NO	) W
					  ON R.DIVISION_ID = W.DIVISION_ID 
					  AND R.FROM_SITE = W.FROM_SITE
					  AND R.ITEM_ID = W.ITEM_ID		
					  AND R.ERP_DO_NO = W.ERP_DO_NO
	
	) X
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS WITH(NOLOCK) 
		  ON MS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID 
		 AND MS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE  
		 AND MS.OPERATION_GROUP < > 'E'
		JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WITH(NOLOCK)
   		  ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIPMENT_RESULT_TYPE' -- LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 
		 AND L.SEGMENT1 = X.TYPE 
		 AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M WITH(NOLOCK) 
		          ON  M.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID 
					AND M.FROM_SITE = X.FROM_SITE 
					AND M.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID 
					AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE 1=1	
	AND ( ( @PARAM_DIVISION_ID   IS NULL OR @PARAM_DIVISION_ID ='')  OR X.DIVISION_ID  = @PARAM_DIVISION_ID ) 
	AND ( ( @PARAM_COMPANY_ID   IS NULL OR @PARAM_COMPANY_ID ='')  OR MS.COMPANY_ID  = @PARAM_COMPANY_ID )
	AND ( ( @PARAM_FROM_SITE   IS NULL OR @PARAM_FROM_SITE ='')  OR X.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(@PARAM_FROM_SITE,',')) )
	AND ( ( @PARAM_ITEM_ID   IS NULL OR @PARAM_ITEM_ID ='')  OR X.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(@PARAM_ITEM_ID,',')) )	
	AND ( ( @PARAM_ERP_DO_NO   IS NULL OR @PARAM_ERP_DO_NO ='')  OR X.ERP_DO_NO IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(@PARAM_ERP_DO_NO,',')) )
	AND ( ( @PARAM_PACKER_YN   IS NULL OR @PARAM_PACKER_YN ='')  OR MS.OSP_YN = @PARAM_PACKER_YN )	
	AND ( ( @PARAM_NORMAL_YN   IS NULL OR @PARAM_NORMAL_YN ='')  OR X.NORMAL_YN = @PARAM_NORMAL_YN )	
	AND ( ( @PARAM_GAP_YN   IS NULL OR @PARAM_GAP_YN ='' OR @PARAM_GAP_YN ='N')  OR ( @PARAM_GAP_YN = 'Y' AND  X.QTY - X.WQTY > 0 ) )	
		
	--ORDER BY X.DIVISION_ID, X.FROM_SITE, X.YYYYMMDD, X.ITEM_ID, X.TO_SITE, L.DISPLAY_SEQ, X.CONFIRM_ID

DESCRIPTION: 82번 사업부의 SSPM Inventory Days 변경이력 확인
DQ_TEXT:
SELECT TOP 10000 * FROM(

,CONVERT(NVARCHAR,  LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 112) AS  LAST_UPDATE_DATE
, DIVISION_ID
, PROJECT_CODE
, SCM_SITE_ID
, ITEM_ID
, CONSENSUS_MKT
, CONSENSUS_ESS
, CONSENSUS_SCM
, INVENTORY_DAY

, DIVISION_ID

, CONSENSUS_SCM

, VALID_YN
, BPMS_EXIST
, CREATED_BY
, CREATION_DATE
, LAST_UPDATED_BY
, LAST_UPDATE_DATE

SELECT Contents, LOOKUP_TYPE, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4, SEGMENT5, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 최소 가동율(평준화)' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_MIN_OPERATION'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 운송모드 BLOCK' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_BOD_BLOCKING'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE5 <> b.ATTRIBUTE5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 <> b.ATTRIBUTE6
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE6 >= b.ATTRIBUTE5 AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 <= b.ATTRIBUTE6)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE6 >= a.ATTRIBUTE5 AND b.ATTRIBUTE6 <= a.ATTRIBUTE6)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE5 <= b.ATTRIBUTE5 AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 >= b.ATTRIBUTE6)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 활성화 LT 구간별' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_FORMATION_LT'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 <> b.ATTRIBUTE3
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE4 <> b.ATTRIBUTE4
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE4 >= b.ATTRIBUTE3 AND a.ATTRIBUTE4 <= b.ATTRIBUTE4)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE4 >= a.ATTRIBUTE3 AND b.ATTRIBUTE4 <= a.ATTRIBUTE4)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE3 <= b.ATTRIBUTE3 AND a.ATTRIBUTE4 >= b.ATTRIBUTE4)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 활성화 수율 구간별' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_FORMATION_PERIOD_YIELD'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 전진검사' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_FORWARD_INSPECTION'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 = b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 = b.ATTRIBUTE3
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE4 = b.ATTRIBUTE4
		AND ISNULL(a.ATTRIBUTE9,'ZZ') = ISNULL(b.ATTRIBUTE9,'ZZ')
		AND ISNULL(a.ATTRIBUTE10,'ZZ') = ISNULL(b.ATTRIBUTE10,'ZZ')
		AND ISNULL(a.ATTRIBUTE11,'ZZ') = ISNULL(b.ATTRIBUTE11,'ZZ')

		AND a.ATTRIBUTE5 <> b.ATTRIBUTE5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 <> b.ATTRIBUTE6
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE6 >= b.ATTRIBUTE5 AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 <= b.ATTRIBUTE6)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE6 >= a.ATTRIBUTE5 AND b.ATTRIBUTE6 <= a.ATTRIBUTE6)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE5 <= b.ATTRIBUTE5 AND a.ATTRIBUTE6 >= b.ATTRIBUTE6)

	UNION ALL

	--A 타입인데 stage가 from: MDLE, to: MDLEBIZ가 아니거나, from/to site가 plant/sales가 아닐때
	SELECT 
		N'[데이터 이상-A Type의 Stage나 site 정보 확인 필요] 전진검사' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_FORWARD_INSPECTION'
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND SEGMENT4 = 'A'
		AND (
			ATTRIBUTE2 != 'MDLE' 
			OR ATTRIBUTE4 != 'MDLEBIZ' 
			OR 'PLANT' != (SELECT SITE_TYPE FROM SCM_MST_SITE WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DIVISION_ID = SEGMENT3 AND SCM_SITE_ID = ATTRIBUTE1)
			OR 'SALES' != (SELECT SITE_TYPE FROM SCM_MST_SITE WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DIVISION_ID = SEGMENT3 AND SCM_SITE_ID = ATTRIBUTE3)
			)

	UNION ALL

	--B 타입인데 stage가 from: MDLE, to: MDLE가 아니거나, from/to site가 plant가 아닐때
	SELECT 
		N'[데이터 이상-B Type의 Stage나 site 정보 확인 필요] 전진검사' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_FORWARD_INSPECTION'
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND SEGMENT4 = 'B'
		AND (
			ATTRIBUTE2 != 'MDLE' 
			OR ATTRIBUTE4 != 'MDLE' 
			OR 'PLANT' != (SELECT SITE_TYPE FROM SCM_MST_SITE WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DIVISION_ID = SEGMENT3 AND SCM_SITE_ID = ATTRIBUTE1)
			OR 'PLANT' != (SELECT SITE_TYPE FROM SCM_MST_SITE WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DIVISION_ID = SEGMENT3 AND SCM_SITE_ID = ATTRIBUTE3)
			)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] 자재/포장재의 입고 예정정보' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_INCOMMING_MATERIAL' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT1, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT1, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 출하 계획 포장재 제약' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_PACKING_EQUIPMENT'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 <> b.ATTRIBUTE3
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE3 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 <= b.ATTRIBUTE3)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE3 >= a.ATTRIBUTE2 AND b.ATTRIBUTE3 <= a.ATTRIBUTE3)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 >= b.ATTRIBUTE3)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 선행생산 일수(max_cover_day)' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_PRECEDE'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] 안전 재고(min_cover_day)' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_SAFETY_STOCK'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT

	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_SAFETY_STOCK_QTY'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE5 = b.ATTRIBUTE5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] 형교환' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_SETUP' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE2 = b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT1, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT1, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] Sales site별 우선순위' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_TOSITE_PRIORITY'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE1 <> b.ATTRIBUTE1
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE2 >= a.ATTRIBUTE1 AND b.ATTRIBUTE2 <= a.ATTRIBUTE2)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE1 <= b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] Group Master' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_DEMAND_GROUP' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT1, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT1, b.ATTRIBUTE1, b.ATTRIBUTE2, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] 생산 Fix' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_PROD_FIX' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE2 = b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE3 = b.ATTRIBUTE3 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT1, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT1, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[구간 중복] Ramp up' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	JOIN 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
	ON 
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_RAMPUP'
		AND a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE
		AND a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2
		AND a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3
		AND a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4
		AND a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE2 <> b.ATTRIBUTE2
		AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 <> b.ATTRIBUTE3
		AND a.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND b.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	WHERE (a.ATTRIBUTE3 >= b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 <= b.ATTRIBUTE3)
		OR (b.ATTRIBUTE3 >= a.ATTRIBUTE2 AND b.ATTRIBUTE3 <= a.ATTRIBUTE3)
		OR (a.ATTRIBUTE2 <= b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND a.ATTRIBUTE3 >= b.ATTRIBUTE3)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] Capa 임시' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_MASTER_CAPA_TEMP' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT4 = b.SEGMENT4 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE1 = b.ATTRIBUTE1 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE2 = b.ATTRIBUTE2 AND
				a.ATTRIBUTE3 = b.ATTRIBUTE3 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT1, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT1, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)

	UNION ALL

	SELECT 
		N'[중복 데이터] 비조업 정리본' as Contents
		,a.LOOKUP_TYPE, a.SEGMENT2, a.SEGMENT3, a.SEGMENT4,a.SEGMENT5, a.ATTRIBUTE1, a.ATTRIBUTE2, a.ATTRIBUTE3, a.ATTRIBUTE4, a.ATTRIBUTE5, a.ATTRIBUTE6, a.ATTRIBUTE7, a.ATTRIBUTE8, a.ATTRIBUTE9, a.ATTRIBUTE10
	FROM 
		SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL a
	WHERE
		a.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_MASTER_NOWORK2_TEMP' AND
		a.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL b
			WHERE 
				a.LOOKUP_TYPE = b.LOOKUP_TYPE AND
				a.SEGMENT1 = b.SEGMENT1 AND
				a.SEGMENT2 = b.SEGMENT2 AND
				a.SEGMENT3 = b.SEGMENT3 AND
				a.SEGMENT5 = b.SEGMENT5 AND

				a.VALID_YN = b.VALID_YN AND
				CONCAT(a.SEGMENT4, a.DISPLAY_SEQ) != CONCAT(b.SEGMENT4, b.DISPLAY_SEQ) 
		)
) MAIN
WHERE 1=1
AND LOOKUP_TYPE = (CASE WHEN @PARAM_LOOKUP_TYPE = '' THEN LOOKUP_TYPE ELSE @PARAM_LOOKUP_TYPE END )

,ATTRIBUTE5	
,ATTRIBUTE6	
,ATTRIBUTE7	
,ATTRIBUTE8	
,ATTRIBUTE9

	SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM [dbo].[SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN]  AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID 
	AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD 
	AND A.PLAN_TYPE = B.PLAN_TYPE
)
